title: 5 Civilization Resource Pack
description:
This Resource Pack makes texture for epic weapons.  

Intended for items from my Five Civilization World. But can be used as a template for Custom model data items.
body:
This resource pack contains textures for all custom item in the Five Civilization world. It contains custom swords, axe, and bows using custom model data. You may use this as a template.

How to get custom weapons?
Open up chat and put one of these it as a commmand.

/give @a bow[custom_model_data={strings:["archeria_bow"]}]

/give @a iron_axe[custom_model_data={strings:["spider_cleaver"]}]

/give @a netherite_sword[custom_model_data={strings:["rune_sword"]}]
